page3_s1.section_title: TravAssist Boatside® On-Water Towing and Assistance with No Out-of-Pocket Expenses1.
page3_s1.raw_text: As a Travelers Boat or Yacht insurance customer, you're invited to download the TravAssist Boatside app. Now you can enjoy boating season knowing you have on-water towing and assistance at your fingertips2.TravAssist Boatside Premier

page3_s2.raw_text: On-Water Towing and Assistance Coverage is optional, and is available for just $25 a year per watercraft.

Towing and Assistance reimbursement will be up to the limits of your policy and excludes the cost of fuel, oil, parts or loaned battery. 2. There are no guarantees that an authorized service provider will be available in an emergency situation. If that is the case, you must immediately contact the US Coast Guard or appropriate state, local or federal government agency for assistance. 3. The app is available for any policyholder to download, however purchase of Premier-On Water Towing and Assistance Coverage is required to access certain features of the app including requesting on-water towing assistance and making a claim. 4. If any of the information on the Declarations has changed, appears incorrect, or is missing, please advise your agent or Travelers representative. We also need you to check our website at www.travelers.com/discounts to ensure that you are receiving all the discounts for which you are eligible.
